scenarios.name: Cargo Outbound Process
scenarios.purpose: Purpose: Bidders to demonstrate the cargo outbound processes as per documentation provided from acceptance to ramp outbound to ensure the capability of the system is aligned with the operational requirement of MABKargo.
scenarios.situation: The system should be able to process the commands required for each operational processes and integrate with existing Logistics Management System (LMS) as the primary interface.
scenarios.demonstration:
Key capabilities to be demonstrated include:
1. Acceptance Process
2. Build Up Process
3. Storage Process for Outbound
4. Ramp Outbound Process
5. Irregularity Handling
scenarios.output:
1. Integrated system between Warehouse Management System (WMS) & Logistics Management System (LMS) for Outbound Cargo Process. 
2. Full demonstration of cargo outbound processes aligned with general air cargo process OR MABKargo's current processes.
scenarios.evaluation: Alignment, Process, Understanding of Air Cargo Process

scenarios.name: Reporting Preparation
scenarios.purpose: Purpose: Bidders to produce the reports required in the documentation given to ensure the system has the capabilities to provide transparency to MABKargo for its machine availability and performance.
scenarios.situation: The system must provide comprehensive reporting capabilities that enable operational transparency, support proactive maintenance planning, optimize resource utilization, and facilitate management decision-making through reliable and exportable reports.
scenarios.demonstration:
The bidder shall demonstrate the system's capability to generate, configure, filter, schedule and export the following reports:
1. System Performance Report
2. Machine Availability Report
3. Machine Fault Analysis Report
4. Machine Health Report
5. Inventory Report
6. System and Machine Utilization Report
7. Optimization Report
Report parameter selection, filtering by date/equipment/location, drill-down capability, dashboard visualization (if available), scheduled report generation, and export to common formats (PDF/Excel/CSV) should be demonstrated.
scenarios.output:
1. Reports are generated accurately using historical data if available, or using data the captures the operational efficiency of Cargo Terminal Operators. 
2. Users are allowed to schedule or automate recurring reports generation for MABKargo's utilization.

steps.title: Select report family
steps.action: Choose report and date / equipment / location parameters

steps.title: Filter and drill down
steps.action: Apply filters and inspect supporting machine or inventory transactions

steps.title: Visualize trends
steps.action: Render KPI, trend and exception visualizations from dynamic data

steps.title: Schedule recurring output
steps.action: Create automated report schedule and recipient list

steps.title: Export evidence
steps.action: Download report data and preserve filter / generated-at metadata

scenarios.name: Maintenance Readiness
scenarios.purpose: Purpose: Bidders to provide the system that related on maintenance which include the graphical user on the maintenance strategy, planning and decision as well.
scenarios.situation: The system must be able to provide the maintenance strategy and planning. The strategy include to optimize the resources and make sure the availability of the machine is sustain to avoid jeopardize to the operations.
scenarios.demonstration:
The bidder shall demonstrate the system's capability to plan and strategize the maintenance to optimize the resources align with the machine availability. It is include the following capability:
1. Strategy on Maintenance Optimization
2. Maintenance Planning Upon Breakdown
3. Equipment Availability Calculation on Service Level Availability
scenarios.output:
1. System able to planning the maintenance accordingly without jeopardize the operations
2. The system interface have a friendly graphical

steps.title: Inspect machine health
steps.action: Review health scores, counters, inspections and trend signals

steps.title: Inject breakdown
steps.action: Record fault, affected cargo task, downtime start and severity

steps.title: Plan maintenance response
steps.action: Select technician, spare, service window and alternate routing

steps.title: Recover equipment
steps.action: Complete repair, safety checks and return machine to service

steps.title: Calculate availability
steps.action: Calculate uptime / planned time and show downtime evidence

steps.title: Publish management pack
steps.action: Generate daily, weekly and monthly performance / fault reports

scenarios.name: System Integration Planning
scenarios.purpose: Purpose: Bidders to present the system integration planning to ensure that seamless integration is proposed for enhanced operational efficiency  within MABKargo's warehouse.
scenarios.situation: The system must have the capabilities to process the commands directed from the Logistics Management System (LMS) to ensure that the cargo handling processes are per the functional requirement. The system must also be able to integrate with current LMS and act as an executor for the commands and record the movements of the cargo vice versa.
scenarios.demonstration:
Key capabiltiies include: 
1. Full integration with Logistics Management System (LMS). 
2. System must be able to integrate with the MH Internal Systems Scope.
3. Integration planning proposed must be viable for operations on day to day basis.
scenarios.output: 1. A fully integrated system with current Logistics Management System (LMS)  acting as the interface and the Warehouse Management System (WMS) acting as the executor.

requirements.name: Acceptance
requirements.description:
1. Retrieval of EMPTY BINA/BOXA
a)The proposed system must be able to receive and process command from LMS for retrieval of EMPTY BINA or BOXA as per requested by officer in charge.
Accept or process the following data in the message:
- BINA or BOXA type
- Number of cages requested
- Target output lane (output lane area)
- Final to Location 
b)Retrieve and place the requested number of cages in the provided target area, update and displayed the Final ""To Location"" in Out Lane Screen.
2.Storage of Accepted Loose Cargo
The proposed system must be able to receive and process Storage Media (BINA & BOXA), AWB and update storage location to LMS.
3. The system must be able to trigger transport command to inform LMS the Storage Media (BINA & BOXA ) is "inmove" status.
System should be able to inform/update user regarding the status of the Storage Media (BINA & BOXA ) either "full" or "empty".
4. The system must be able to notify LMS on the deviation of regular movement (destination occupied, location not available, machine fault during transfer).
5. System must be able to trigger command to LMS that the Storage Media (BINA & BOXA) has arrived at the transport destination and update final location to LMS.
6. Storage of Acceptance /Trucking (ULD)
The proposed system must be able to receive and process intact ULD, ULD Number, ULD Weight (for UWS), AWB and update the location to LMS
6. The system must be able to trigger transport command to inform LMS the Storage Media (ULD, IHCA)is "inmove" status
7. System should be able to inform/update user regarding the status of the Storage Media (ULD, IHCA ) either "full" or "empty"
8. The system must be able to notify LMS on the deviation of regular movement (destination occupied, location not available, machine fault during transfer)
9. System must be able to trigger command to LMS that the Storage Media (ULD, IHCA) has arrived at the transport destination and update the final location to LMS

requirements.name: Cargo Build Up
requirements.description:
1. System must be able to process command from LMS to initiate retrieval process of  Storage Media (BINA,BOXA, ULD, IHCA) from auto storage location.
2. System must be able to to transfer the Storage Media (BINA,BOXA, ULD, IHCA) to the desired location based on transport command from LMS.
3. The system must be able to notify LMS on the deviation of regular movement (destination occupied, location not available, machine fault during transfer)
4. System must be able to trigger command to LMS that the ULD has arrived at the desired location.
5. The proposed system must be able to transmit final location of ULD Cargo to LMS
6. The system must be able to transmit weight information of ULD Cargo to LMS
7. Once BUP completed, the system must be able to receive and process transport command from LMS to transfer the storage media from workstation to TTV for final weight and storage location. 
8. The system must be able to trigger the final weight (UWS) to LMS for UWS purpose.

requirements.name: General Requirement
requirements.description:
1. System propose by Bidders to be user friendly and interactive graphical user interface for warehouse operation's utilization. 
2. Solution must be designed with sufficient flexibility to remain adaptable for the next 10 years. 
3. Solution must be future proof min next 10 years
4. Solution to have Induction of advanced automation & robotics technology where applicable to improve cargo handling process with higher efficiency, cycle time and productivity

requirements.name: Maintenance Strategy
requirements.description:
Bidders to demonstrate a maintenance system that is capable for: 
• Equipment performance checks and inspections
• Condition monitoring and trend analysis
• Adjustments, lubrication, and cleaning
• Routine replacement of wear‑and‑tear components
• Testing of safety devices and statutory compliance
• Predictive maintenance techniques
• Maintenance of technical documentation and library
• Supply of consumables (lubricants, cleaning materials, etc.)
Bidders to propose any additional maintenance scope of work which is relevant.

requirements.name: System Availability
requirements.description: Bidders to demonstrate on how the system availability to be calculated through the formula, the monitoring tools used, the measurement period, and how downtime is recorded and reported. Targeted output for System Avaialbiltiy for Cargo Application must be at 98% during demonstration.

requirements.name: Management Reporting
requirements.description:
Bidders to demonstrate system that would be able to showcase the management reporting as per below: 
• Work planning and coordination
• Spare parts and consumables management
• Electronic Maintenance Management System (EMMS) operation and reporting
• Health, Safety, and statutory compliance
• Technical documentation management
• Monthly performance reporting
• Attendance at Client management meetings
• Periodic management and SLA reviews
• Daily Maintenance Summary Report
• Weekly Maintenance Inspection Walkabout Report
• Fault Reports (as required)
• Monthly Equipment Performance and Availability Report
• Monthly Fault Analysis Report
• Predictive Maintenance Reports (e.g. thermography)
